title: kb entry — one atomic claim (4.3)
description: One claim per file. The store is authoritative for knowledge (P14) whether or not a librarian agent exists to serve it.

kind.description: a dimensionless_group carries a formula instead of a value (5.7)

validity_conditions.description: under what conditions the claim holds; a claim without them is not reusable

validity.description: the machine-readable half of validity_conditions (4.3.1). Where the two disagree this one wins (P3): prose cannot be matched against a query condition_range. An entry without it is returned flagged unconstrained rather than matching silently.

source.description: Where the claim came from, in the same form a card's number uses (5.3), so that an entry's grade is DERIVED and not self-reported (check 43). source_ref says which document; this says what kind of evidence it is, and only the second one fixes a grade. Optional while the store catches up: entries written before the field existed are counted rather than failed.

grade_tag.description: the sub-rank inside a grade, mostly to separate the kinds of E3 (4.3). Its load-bearing use is the citation order among literature: peer_reviewed -> textbook -> vendor_spec -> preprint. The other values exist so the enum is not silently incomplete -- an operator reading is E3 by 5.3 and had no value here, so every such entry left this null and a null read as an omission rather than a kind.

identifiers.description: Exact names for the thing the claim is about: part_number, lot, catalog_number, position, slot. A nominal designation is exact by definition and carries no uncertainty (5.3), so it belongs here and never in numbers[]. Until this existed a table with part numbers could not become an entry at all, which is why the objective and particle registries stayed in staging.

additionalProperties.description: a string even when it looks like a number. A position stored as 0 invites arithmetic on positions and a magnification stored as 20 invites a decimal point; the driver converts at the call site.

conflict_with.description: contradictory entries are both kept and marked, never merged (4.3)

curated_by.description: who put it here. Until M3 that is a person, not the librarian agent.
